vlog_arc.theme: Show up before the world asks you to.

beats.mon: Leo films the 5am alarm going off, pours the first cup, and says simply: this week I want to show you what it actually looks like to build something before the noise starts.
beats.tue: Standing in the kitchen after a training session, Leo shares one thing that went wrong in last week's content pipeline and what he's changing — no spin, just the honest debrief.
beats.wed: Leo holds up the ingredient panel and explains, in one minute, why he chose Ginkgo biloba over a cheaper alternative two years ago and what he'd tell his past self now.
beats.thu: Quick reel from the desk: Leo reads a real buyer message aloud, pauses on the line 'day three, something shifted,' and says that sentence is exactly why he kept going when the early numbers were slow.
beats.fri: Leo walks through the week's content results — what landed, what didn't, one number he's proud of — framing it as a public ledger, not a highlight reel.
beats.sat: Weekend morning with the kids visible in the background: Leo makes two cups, one for him, one for his wife, and talks for thirty seconds about why presence after a hard week is the whole point.
beats.sun: Leo sits down, camera close, and says: next week I'm testing something new with the formula communication — I don't know if it'll work, but I'll show you either way.
